name: dejavu-gates
description: Cross-session error gates for AI coding agents: recurring tool-call failures are promoted into enforced remind-first, block-on-repeat gates via PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Error gates that turn recurring tool-call failures into enforced reminders and blocks
interface.longDescription: dejavu watches tool-call failures and promotes a recurring pattern (3 failures across 2 distinct sessions) into an enforced gate: a reminder with a correction on the next attempt, a hard block on same-session repeat offense. Diagnostics never block, they annotate. Gates persist across sessions and share one harness-neutral store across Codex CLI, Claude Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot CLI, Crush, Devin CLI, Kiro and Cline.
